_meta.purpose: Explicit alias table -- the cheap, declarative half of canonicalization (diary F18, gap 3). Maps surface forms to canonical concept keys. Loaded by ether_consolidate.py; alias hits override any automatic resolution.
_meta.note: Safe default is to UNDER-merge: splitting a concept loses count and is recoverable; over-merging fuses two histories and corrupts the F18 familiarity snapshots. Only add aliases you are willing to declare identical.

hot-tier.label: HOT
hot-tier.holds: live context window; verbatim, equally weighted

warm-tier.label: WARM
warm-tier.holds: high-activation neighborhoods one hop away; compressed episodes

cold-tier.label: COLD
cold-tier.holds: persistent store: gist, concepts, edges; slow generative retrieval

ether-tier.label: ETHER
ether-tier.holds: content-free residues; familiarity only; never evicted; no promotion to content

familiarity-sketch.label: Familiarity sketch
familiarity-sketch.holds: counting filter implementing ETHER; min-estimator read-out

concept-library.label: Concept library
concept-library.holds: canonical concept nodes; the identity authority other structures cite

association-graph.label: Association graph
association-graph.holds: typed weighted edges citing concept ids; spreading activation

episode-record.label: Episode record
episode-record.holds: reference bag + gist + familiarity snapshot + recall list

familiarity-snapshot.label: Familiarity snapshot
familiarity-snapshot.holds: frozen readout of sketch familiarity at capture time; the only readout-rung content

recall-list.label: Recall list
recall-list.holds: last ~5 recall references per concept in an episode; answers where-have-I-seen-this

index.label: Index
index.holds: entry points into the graph from concepts, edges and keywords

deposit-manifest.label: Deposit manifest
deposit-manifest.holds: one interaction's extracted keys and weights, provenance-labeled

capture.label: Capture
capture.holds: hook-side, zero-model: dedupe, enqueue, weak deposit

consolidation.label: Consolidation
consolidation.holds: offline batch: encode, refine, deposit at full weight, age

deposit.label: Deposit
deposit.holds: an activation entering the sketch; increments k counters by weight

aging.label: Aging
aging.holds: periodic counter decay; weak traces vanish first
